Substitute \(y=\sqrt3(x-\frac p2)\) into \(y^2=2px\):

\[
3\left(x-\frac p2\right)^2=2px
\]
\[
12x^2-20px+3p^2=0
\]
\[
x=\frac{20p\pm16p}{24}
\]
so
\[
x=\frac{3p}{2}\quad \text{or}\quad x=\frac p6.
\]

Using the line parameter \(x=\frac p2+t,\ y=\sqrt3 t\), distance from \(F\) is \(2|t|\).

For \(x=\frac{3p}{2}\), \(t=p\), so \(|AF|=2p\).  
For \(x=\frac p6\), \(t=-\frac p3\), so \(|BF|=\frac{2p}{3}\).

Thus,
\[
\frac{|AF|}{|BF|}=\frac{2p}{2p/3}=3.
\]

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
